item.title: Version 1.0.0 Beta
item.description:
• Initial Beta release of Sangeet AI for private testers.
  • Includes native SwiftUI UI Dashboard and Audio Engine integrations.
  • Features native in-app feedback channel connected straight to beta@sangeet.app.
  • Optimized DeepFilterNet 3 and clicks restoration stages.
